pickedRecipient.description: The person this participant gives a gift to. Name and email are both empty before the hat is shaken, and the name is 'Hidden' until the hat is closed.

eligibleRecipients.description: The people this participant is allowed to draw. People rather than names, because two participants may share a name.

emoji.description: The face this participant is marked with wherever they are named. One of a closed list the application offers, so it is safe to render as it stands.

deliveryStatus.description: How far the last email sent to this participant is known to have got: SENT, DELIVERED, DELAYED, BOUNCED, COMPLAINED, REJECTED or FAILED. Empty when nothing has been heard yet, which is not the same as not delivered.

deliveryDetail.description: Why, for the statuses that have a why: the bounce subtype and the receiving server's diagnostic. Empty otherwise. Written by a remote mail server, so it is neither moderated nor trusted.

deliveryMessageType.description: Which of this application's emails the status above is about: INVITATION, COMPLETION, PARTICIPANT_LEFT, ORGANIZER_LEFT_NOTE or UNSPECIFIED. Empty when nothing has been heard yet.

deliveryOccurredAt.description: When SES says the event behind the status happened, or the minimum date when nothing has been heard yet.

email.description: The email address of the person.
